concept: The Hue Dial: one turn of a colour dial drives every swatch; the last turn lands on tangerine, last frame = first frame
motionStyle: virtual camera over the live page (macro push, pull-back, whips, 3D tilt, speed-ramped spin), springs on type, hard cuts on downbeats
primaryTransition: match cut on colour (tangerine swatch -> tangerine dial read-out)
transitions: iris wipe from the CTA (loop seam)
typeTreatment: template type system (Gabarito 900 / Martian Mono), per-word mask reveals locked to the beat, max 6 words per card
grade: template colours kept true; grain, vignette that closes in the breath, highlight bloom, contrast 1.04 / saturation 1.05
sound: 120 BPM E-minor pentatonic: kick/hat/clap, plucked bass, marimba arp, one rising bell note per dial tick, J-cut whooshes, riser and impact, 0.8 s of silence before the reveal
cover: dedicated poster: hook headline + swatch fan on a hue ring, safe for the 1:1 and 3:4 grid crops

variants.A: typographic open: hook words slam on flat tangerine on the beats, hard cut to the page on beat 3 (hypothesis: type-first is the stronger stopper for cold viewers)
variants.B: macro open: tangerine swatch fills the frame and pulls back to the hook (hypothesis: a surprising image beats text for scroll-stopping)

concept: After 8 (night-signal cut): the clinic's light-drawn facade goes dark at 8 pm; at 11:42 pm a patient's WhatsApp message lights a phone in the dark, the website answers, the camera pulls back to the system (hub -> slot / deposit / reminder) with data flowing, a scan bar turns the chat into Dantika's slot calendar, brackets lock Thursday 9:30, the phone flies into a night diary that fills, a held breath, sunrise turns the bookings gold, CTA, and the facade relights at 9 am (the loop)
motionStyle: product-film grammar: one centred focal object per shot, springs, connector lines drawing on the beat with travelling data dots, counter-rotating hub rings, scan-bar transformation, corner-bracket focus with a small push-in, the phone flying into the next shot's element, scale punch on the sunrise
primaryTransition: scan-bar transformation (a bar of light runs down the phone and turns the chat into the slot calendar)
transitions: neon flicker: OPEN -> CLOSED at 8 pm
phone rises out of the dark
pull back to the system (phone shrinks to the top of the diagram)
phone flies into its diary slot
facade redraws, OPEN flickers on at 9 am
typeTreatment: captions as the spine: Archivo 800 wdth 84, -0.035em, 1-3 words per card on a solid dark pill at one fixed anchor (y 492), one accent word per card; mono HUD clock
grade: near-black #050607 with one accent glow (Dantika lime #c8ff3d), material cards with light rims, the brand red only on the booked slot, warm sunrise (amber/coral/violet) only at the payoff
sound: effects only at 100 BPM, every cue motivated: impact as the lights die, whoosh as the phone rises, clicks on the message and the reply, sub on the hub, clicks on each node, riser through the scan, impact on Booked, ticks on each diary fill, riser into the breath, big impact on sunrise; music by Instagram audio near 100 BPM
cover: night poster: question in white with '8 pm?' in lime glow over the lit diary, inside the 1:1 and 3:4 crops

variants.A: type-first open on flat red (owner's choice for the format)

notes: v3 after the owner shared a reference reel: v2's rainbow colour script read as illustration, not product. Rebuilt in a product-film grammar (see design/film-playbook.md). Passes: 1) brackets hidden behind the CTA card and too small on the slot -> brackets live inside their parent, camera pushes into the slot; diary names clipped; sunrise hidden in Instagram's bottom zone -> raised and widened; hub label crossed the centre line; caption 'Slot.' before its node. 2) push-in ran over the captions -> 1.42x and a more solid pill. 3) the white HUD clock ghosted across the zoomed light screen -> hidden during the push; thicker brackets.

concept: 24 minutes: steam-coloured dots assemble into a giant red 24; whip to the menu, one tap (spotlight), the stopwatch starts; zoom through the order bar into the kitchen (steps rail: folded, steamed, packed); whip to the city, a route draws to the door; a held breath at 23:59; DELIVERED slams with a burst; 24:00 in giant type; the order button gets tapped; the dots scatter back (loop)
motionStyle: whips with motion blur and a zoom-through, bare uppercase captions, giant numerals, particle assemble/scatter
typeTreatment: bare uppercase captions (no pills), giant '24' and '24:00', mono stopwatch
grade: deep plum ground (#1a0712), goji red glow, pistachio only for DELIVERED; no warm flood
sound: effects only at 100 BPM: whoosh as the phone rises, click on the tap, sub on the kitchen hub, clicks on fold/steam/pack, ticks during the ride, riser into the 23:59 breath, big impact on delivery; Instagram audio near 100 BPM
cover: giant red 24 under the question, safe in every crop
notes: v3 because v2 reused Dantika's building blocks (phone, hub, brackets, warm flood, card); this cut changes opener, transitions, mechanism, focus, payoff, type, captions, CTA and ground (manifest + check). Pass 1: the spotlight blacked out the whole phone -> lighter, wider circle; empty half second after the zoom -> steps start at 5.25; the giant 24:00 collided with the 'Still hot.' caption -> giant leaves at 14.05. Pass 2: full-size check of the tap, kitchen and payoff frames. Pass 3: full render contact sheet (exits at 3.5/4.5 s and the 15.5 s fade read as motion, not dead air). Music: 100 BPM grid kept (brief flags the repeat; the owner picks Instagram audio, genre differs). v4 (owner: watermark + use the space): Aquarii Web Studio watermark on every frame; phone 290 px wide running off the bottom, 24 fills the width, kitchen steps at 34 px with a ghost '09' bleeding off the right, the city map edge to edge, a long route, 88 px end type and a full-width button. Fill meter: 15 of 20 frames tight -> 8 of 20 (transitions and the breath). Found and fixed a bug: the mono font name broke every inline style that used it (the DELIVERED sub-line rendered huge).

motionStyle: light ground, rack-focus opener, blinds then iris transitions, dial mechanism, magnifier focus, sweep payoff
typeTreatment: blur-reveal captions on dark pills, giant FRESH., Bagel Fat One brand moments
grade: foam white-blue ground, sky blue plan scene, hot pink accent, no dark flood
sound: effects only at 100 BPM; Instagram audio: bouncy light funk near 100 BPM
cover: 7 PM over a closed shutter with 'Who skips your laundry?'
notes: Pass 1: contact sheet of 16 stills; lens covered the price and printed small text off-centre -> moved to the small print and shrunk its text; '/ week' touched the 4 -> moved right. Cover repeated '7 PM' and wrapped badly -> new cover line. Pass 2: re-rendered plan and cover stills; fill meter 2 of 17 tight (breath and last frame). Not yet reviewed as a full render; the workflow renders it after deploy. Loop: frame 0 and last frame share the shutter and a blurred 7 PM; the first hook caption is mid-reveal at frame 0. Review pass (Claude, 14 Oct morning): frame 0 was a pale full blur with a half-formed caption (nothing to stop on) -> the rack focus starts mid-pull so frame 0 shows a huge, almost sharp 7 PM and a readable hook; the last second was nearly empty and did not match frame 0 -> the sharp 7 PM returns at 17.0 and pushes into the exact frame-0 state (the override runs after P.update, otherwise the part re-hides it).
